meta.title: Privacy Policy | PREVENT Therapy Space
meta.description: How PREVENT Therapy Space collects and protects your personal data.

p: The controller of your personal data is PREVENT Therapy Space, Theotokopoulou 55, Patisia, Athens, Greece. For any matter regarding your data you can contact us at geokap94@hotmail.com.

When booking an appointment online: full name, email address, phone number, appointment date and time, and any notes you choose to write to us. Notes may include health information that you provide voluntarily.
Through the contact form: full name, email, phone and your message.
The website stores only your language preference on your device (local storage). We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies or analytics tools.
Booking details are used exclusively to schedule, confirm, remind, and — where needed — cancel or reschedule your appointment (performance of a contract, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Any health information in your notes is processed on the basis of your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), which you give when submitting the booking and may withdraw at any time.
Contact form details are used to respond to your request.

Your appointment is recorded in the therapist's professional calendar (Google Calendar — Google Ireland Ltd). Confirmation and reminder emails are sent through the Resend service. The website is hosted on Vercel.
These providers act as processors. Data may be transferred outside the EEA with the safeguards provided by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses).
We never sell or share your data with third parties for advertising purposes.

Appointment details are kept in the therapist's calendar for as long as necessary to organise your therapy and maintain the history of our cooperation. Contact messages are kept for as long as needed to handle your request. You may request deletion at any time.

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection and data portability, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise your rights, contact geokap94@hotmail.com.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
All connections to the website are encrypted (HTTPS). Only the therapist has access to appointment details.
We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is published on this page with its last-updated date.

meta.title: Terms of Use | PREVENT Therapy Space
meta.description: Terms of use for the PREVENT Therapy Space website and online booking system.

p: This website belongs to PREVENT Therapy Space (Theotokopoulou 55, Patisia, Athens, Greece) and provides information about the practice's services as well as online appointment booking. Using the website implies acceptance of these terms.
A booking is completed upon the confirmation you receive by email and calendar invitation. You must provide accurate and up-to-date contact details.
You may cancel your appointment online, through the cancellation link in your email, up to 2 hours before the scheduled time. After that limit, cancellation is possible only by phone.
The practice reserves the right to reschedule or cancel appointments for reasons of force majeure, notifying you promptly at the contact details you have provided.
The content of this website is for information purposes only and does not substitute medical diagnosis, advice or treatment. For any health matter, consult your physician or physiotherapist.
The content of this website (texts, photographs, logos, graphics) is the intellectual property of PREVENT Therapy Space or its licensors and may not be reproduced without permission.
We make every reasonable effort to ensure the accuracy of the information and the availability of the booking system, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation of the website.
These terms are governed by Greek law. The courts of Athens have jurisdiction over any dispute.
